base_cache_dir.description: Root directory where debuginfo files are cached locally.

tmp_dir.description: Directory for temporary files (e.g., partial downloads). Should be on the same filesystem as cache for hardlinking efficiency.

listen_address.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) the server binds to. Use '::' for all interfaces on IPv6.

worker_count.description: Number of worker threads handling requests. Adjust based on CPU cores and load.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections. Exceeding this may cause request rejection or queuing.

compression.description: Whether to enable on-the-fly gzip compression of debuginfo files (reduces bandwidth).

http2.description: Enable HTTP/2 protocol support (requires TLS or reverse proxy termination).

https_cert_path.description: Path to TLS certificate file (PEM format). If empty, server runs HTTP only.

https_key_path.description: Path to TLS private key file (PEM format). Ignored if no cert path.

upstream_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for upstream sources (e.g., distro repos) before timing out a fetch.

cache_max_age.description: Seconds of inactivity after which a cached file is considered stale and eligible for eviction.

min_free_space.description: Minimum free disk space (in bytes) required to accept uploads. Defaults to 5 GB.

max_cache_size.description: Maximum cache size (in bytes). Old files are removed to stay under this limit. Defaults to 100 GB.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logs. Options: debug, info, notice, warning, error, crit, alert, emerg.

upstream_sources.description: List of base URLs for upstream debuginfo repositories (e.g., distro build roots). Requests for missing files will fall back here.

items.description: Base URL of an upstream debuginfo server (e.g., https://debuginfo.example.com/)

enable_db.description: Whether to enable SQLite-backed indexing for faster lookups (e.g., by build-id).

db_path.description: Path to the SQLite database file (used only if indexing is enabled).

rate_limit_per_min.description: Maximum number of requests allowed per IP per minute. Set to 0 to disable rate limiting.

cors_origins.description: List of allowed origins for CORS preflight responses. Use ['*'] to allow all.

items.description: Allowed origin (e.g., https://example.com, or * for wildcard)

healthz.description: Enable the /healthz endpoint for lightweight health checks.
